changes: Hold [TRACK] and press [PAGE] to open SEQ on that track: Euclidean TRIG and PLCK rhythms up to 64 steps.
Lock rhythms for page-1 parameters, and a Harmony page for PTCH and NOTE: scale, root, phrase and jump; voices and chords on MIDI tracks.
[YES] writes sample trigs, note trigs and parameter locks into the pattern; [FUNC] + [BANK] clears them.
Settings are saved per project in seq.work, the same file octabam's SEQ writes.
Closing SEQ after using CUE clears stale references to SEQ from the stock key and encoder cache so Modwerk can unload it.
